tasks.title: Gimbal angle → pulse
tasks.statement: PX4 1.18, AUX output, pitch: `MNT_MIN_PITCH` = **{lo}**°, `MNT_MAX_PITCH` = **{hi}**°, output `MIN` = **{mn}**, `MAX` = **{mx}** µs, no `CENT` set, vehicle in flight, `MNT_DO_STAB` = 1, frame level. Pitch setpoint **{th}**°. How many microseconds on the output?
tasks.answer: mn + ((max(lo, min(hi, th)) / hi if th >= 0 else max(lo, min(hi, th)) / (-lo)) + 1)/2*(mx - mn)
tasks.solution: The order from `output.cpp` and `output_rc.cpp` (v1.18.0): first θ = clamp(θ, `MNT_MIN_PITCH`, `MNT_MAX_PITCH`), then normalization by its own half-axis: θ ≥ 0 → c = θ / `MNT_MAX_PITCH`, θ < 0 → c = θ / |`MNT_MIN_PITCH`|, then `mixer_module`: µs = MIN + (c + 1)/2 · (MAX − MIN). Zero degrees always gives the middle of the output; the limits can be asymmetric. Before 1.18 there was `MNT_RANGE_PITCH` and the `MNT_OFF_PITCH` offset instead of two limits.

tasks.title: Rate mode: angle after holding the stick
tasks.statement: PX4 1.18: `MNT_RC_IN_MODE` = 1, `MNT_RATE_PITCH` = **{rate}** °/s, `MNT_MIN_PITCH` = **{lo}**°, `MNT_MAX_PITCH` = **{hi}**°, `MNT_TAU` = 0. The gimbal is at 0°, the vehicle in flight. The pitch stick is held at **{s}** (fraction of full travel) for **{t}** s. What pitch angle do you get?
tasks.solution: Rate = `MNT_RATE_PITCH` · stick position; the angle accumulates: θ = rate · s · t. The integral stops at `MNT_MIN_PITCH` or `MNT_MAX_PITCH` and grows no further. `MNT_TAU` = 0 is required: with the 0.3 default the filter sits inside the accumulation loop, and the angle grows about 30 times slower (SITL v1.18.0).

tasks.title: TRIG_DISTANCE from overlap
tasks.statement: The frame size on the ground along the track is **{F}** m, the required forward overlap **{p}** %. What value goes into `TRIG_DISTANCE`?
tasks.solution: Trigger distance = F · (1 − p). For example, 90 m and 80 % give 18 m. Where F comes from is in the per-mapping module.

tasks.title: Interval between frames
tasks.statement: `TRIG_MODE` = 4, `TRIG_DISTANCE` = **{D}** m, groundspeed **{v}** m/s. How many seconds apart do the release commands come (ignore the 50 ms driver loop step)?
tasks.solution: T = `TRIG_DISTANCE` / v. Compare T with the camera cycle and with `TRIG_MIN_INTERVA`: if T is shorter than `TRIG_MIN_INTERVA`, the driver skips a release and the spacing doubles.

tasks.title: Number of frames on a leg
tasks.statement: Capture is enabled at the start of a straight leg **{L}** m long, `TRIG_DISTANCE` = **{D}** m. How many release commands does the driver issue over the leg (ideal case, ignoring the 50 ms loop step)?
tasks.solution: The first frame is taken right after capture is enabled, then one every D meters: N = ⌊L / D⌋ + 1.

tasks.title: Geotag error from shutter delay
tasks.statement: No hot shoe feedback. Groundspeed **{v}** m/s, the camera fires **{tau}** ms after the command. How many meters along the track is the position from `camera_capture` from the true capture point?
tasks.solution: Without feedback the log records the moment of the command. In time τ the vehicle covers v · τ: the recorded point lies behind the true one by that amount. A constant τ is removed by a time correction; the spread Δτ remains as an error of v · Δτ.

tasks.title: Speed limit for the camera
tasks.statement: `TRIG_DISTANCE` = **{D}** m, minimum camera cycle **{c}** s. At what highest groundspeed does the camera still capture every frame?
tasks.solution: The condition T = D / v ≥ camera cycle gives v_max = D / cycle. Compute it for the downwind leg: that is where the groundspeed is highest.
